originalTitle: Worth $5m? Visitors react to renovated Washington horse statues
summary: The Trump Administration has regilded the Arts of War statues near the Lincoln Memorial with 23.75-karat gold.
content:
The Trump Administration has regilded the Arts of War statues near the Lincoln Memorial in Washington DC with 23.75-karat gold. The project cost $5.1m according to federal records.

The BBC asked people in Washington what they think of the renovation.
